topic: Deployment status and data validation issues
summary_markdown: The session covered the deployment of new features, confirming that a release was initiated. Initial concerns about data were raised regarding company creation and campaign listing on the production environment (prod). It was noted that neither a new company nor a new campaign could be created or listed by some participants. The issue required further investigation, including checking console logs for errors.
decisions: The feature was released to production.
Further investigation is needed regarding data creation and listing issues on the production environment.
action_items: Check console logs (F12) for errors during testing.
